subject: Fwd: Request: Limited PO waiver for EdgeScale pilot — approval path
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@edgescale.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary PO waiver for EdgeScale pilot

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from EdgeScale — we’re kicking off a short pilot with Redwood (integration test + small production workload) starting May 1. Our procurement team typically requires a PO, but our legal has not finished the master services agreement yet. For speed we’re asking whether Redwood can accept invoices without a PO for the first 90 days while contracts are finalized.

Pilot details: 1) monthly invoices ~USD 3,000–4,500; 2) start May 1; 3) pilot scope attached (Pilot_MutualActionPlan.pdf). We’re attaching our W-9 as well.

If you need a formal PO exemption form to complete on our side, point me to it and I’ll have Nadia fill it out. Otherwise we can agree to an invoice-to billing@redwood.com with a cap and an agreed review date.

Attachments: EdgeScale_W9.pdf, Pilot_MutualActionPlan.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

—Samir Khan
Head of Ops, EdgeScale Inc.
samir.k@edgescale.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@edgescale.com>; Nadia Collins <nadia.collins@edgescale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-25T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO waiver for EdgeScale pilot

Samir — thanks for the note and the attachments. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Laura (Finance) to scope an operational path.

High level: we can consider a limited, conditional PO waiver for a short pilot if the vendor completes a minimal intake and we get a director-level approval internally. We typically require: W-9, contact for invoicing, and a vendor intake form completed. Laura — what additional evidence will you need to approve a 90-day exception?

Suggested guardrails from my side: 90 days max, cumulative cap USD 10k, invoices submitted monthly to billing@redwood.com, and a review 2 weeks before the waiver end to decide whether to enforce PO policy or extend. If legal flags anything, we can hold payments until the signed SLA is in place.

Samir — please complete the attached exemption form (Marissa will send) and confirm billing contact and PO number requirement (if any) on your end.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@edgescale.com>; jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-26T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: PO exemption form and commercial terms

Samir — welcome, excited to get EdgeScale into a pilot. I’m attaching our one-page PO Exemption Form — if you can have Nadia sign and return that it will speed Finance review.

Commercial: confirm monthly invoicing at USD 3,250 (estimate), billing to billing@redwood.com, net 30. If EdgeScale needs our tax or remittance details we’ll provide an invoice routing template.

Attachment: PO_Exemption_Form.docx

Next steps: 1) Nadia returns the completed form; 2) finance verifies W-9 and insurance; 3) internal director approval to activate the temporary exception; 4) we create a temporary vendor code and track spend against the cap.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com; jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: samir.k@edgescale.com
Date: 2028-04-27T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO exemption form and commercial terms

Thanks for the context. For Finance to sign off on a PO waiver we need the following completed and uploaded to the vendor intake ticket:

- Completed vendor intake form (standard fields + remittance)
- Valid W-9 (received)
- Certificate of insurance showing general liability (minimum requirement)
- Signed PO Exemption Form from EdgeScale
- Point of contact for invoice disputes and a billing email address

I’ve attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx to spell this out. Once those are in place I’ll request director-level approval (Olga) and will route an internal temporary vendor code request in ProcSys (ProcSys-9876).

One conditional item: because this is early access to Dedicated integration, Legal should confirm there are no unusual SLA penalties that could create contingent liabilities. Hannah, please flag any operational concerns you see.

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-27T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary PO waiver for EdgeScale pilot — approval request

Olga — forwarding the exchange with EdgeScale. They’re a small platform partner asking for a temporary PO waiver for a 90-day integration pilot (expected spend ~3k–4.5k/mo). Finance requires the checklist noted below but are amenable to granting an exception if we capture:

- Cap of USD 10,000 total for the pilot period
- 90 day max waiver window (May 1–July 29)
- Monthly invoicing to billing@redwood.com, net 30
- Completed vendor intake and PO exemption form uploaded before first invoice
- Legal to confirm no SLA exposures for Redwood beyond standard terms

Could you confirm if you approve a director-level exception with these conditions? If yes, Laura will create the temporary vendor code and I’ll let EdgeScale know.

Forwarded message follows: (see earlier messages and attachments)

—Jonas

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary PO waiver for EdgeScale pilot — approval request

Jonas — I approve a conditional, director-level PO waiver for EdgeScale Inc. with the following explicit conditions: 

1) Total pilot spend capped at USD 10,000; any spend beyond requires procurement escalation and Finance signoff.
2) Waiver valid for 90 days only (May 1–July 29, 2028).
3) EdgeScale must return a fully completed PO Exemption Form and vendor intake documents (W-9, COI) before the first invoice is paid.
4) Monthly invoices must be sent to billing@redwood.com and coded to the temporary vendor code that Finance will create.
5) Legal must sign off on the Master Services Agreement; if Legal requests changes that increase Redwood liability, Finance may suspend payments until resolved.

I have attached my signed approval slip and request Laura to log ProcSys-9876 and create the temporary vendor record. Please track the waiver as an exception in our procurement log and schedule a review two weeks before July 29.

Attachment: PO_Waiver_Approval_signed.pdf

—Olga Petrov
Director, Procurement & Vendor Governance
olga_petrov@redwood.com
